message.entry:
Use the method to add or remove Bus classes from a_Bus.
< When adding a Bus class > >> obj.add_bus(BUS_INSTANCE) < When removing a Bus class > >> obj.aremove_bus('BUS_TAG')

Use the method to add or remove Branch classes from a_Bus.
< When adding a Branch class > >> obj.add_bus(BRANCH_INSTANCE,['BUSi_TAG','BUSj_TAG']) < When removing a Bus class > >> obj.aremove_bus('BRANCH_TAG')

Use the method to add or remove Global Controller classes from a_Bus.
< When adding a Global Controller class > >> obj.add_bus(GlobalCon_INSTANCE,[ComponentTag]) < When removing a Global Controller class > >> obj.aremove_bus(GlobalCon_TAG)
Cost and Constraint of the optimal power flow must be function handles @(v, p) ... (or [] for none).
''{0}'' has no buses, so the power flow has no slack bus. Add buses with net.add_bus() and components with bus.add_component(...).
No bus of ''{0}'' has a component, so the power flow cannot select a slack bus. Add a generator to a bus with bus.add_component(...). A bus with a component that has Q = NaN is selected first.
No bus with the tag ''{0}'' was found in ''{1}''.
No branch with the tag ''{0}'' was found in ''{1}''. List the tags of the network with string(net.a_Branch).
Bus index {0} is out of range: ''{1}'' has {2} buses. Add the buses first with net.add_bus(), or give the end buses as indices of net.a_Bus or as bus tags.
Both ends of the branch are bus ''{0}''. A branch must connect two different buses. For a shunt at the bus, use net.add_bus(Gshunt=G, Bshunt=B) instead of a branch.
The branch between ''{0}'' and ''{1}'' has R = X = 0, so its admittance is infinite. Give a nonzero R or X, or merge the two buses into one.
Bus ''{0}'' is connected to the branches {1}. Remove them first with net.remove_branch(TAG), or remove them together with >> net.remove_bus(BUS_TAG, "RemoveBranches", true)
The components {0} on the removed bus are controlled by the global controller ''{1}''. Remove the global controller first with net.remove_global_controller(TAG).
A global controller with the tag ''{0}'' is already in ''{1}''. Give the new controller another tag, or remove the existing one first with net.remove_global_controller(TAG).
The global controller ''{0}'' cannot control ''{1}'': the class {2} has no {3}. Choose a component that has them.
The global controller ''{0}'' is connected: {1}.
No global controller with the tag ''{0}'' was found in ''{1}''.
Unknown Owner {0} for net.disp_connection: ''{1}'' has no bus, component or controller with these tags. List the tags with net.disp_tree().
The Method of net.initialize must be one of {0}.
Options for net.initialize must be given as Name-Value pairs, e.g. net.initialize(Method="OPF").
Unknown option ''{0}'' for net.initialize(Method="equilibrium"). Valid options: Method.

net.initialize(Method="powerflow") stopped: the power flow did not converge ({0}). The network was not changed. Check tab_parameter.powerflow of the buses and components, or change the solver settings, e.g. net.initialize(MaxIteration=...) or the Method of the PowerFlowCalculation section of GUILDA.setting.

net.initialize(Method="OPF") stopped: the AC optimal power flow was not solved ({0}). The network was not changed. Relax the constraints (tab_parameter.operation of the buses, components and branches), change the solver settings (e.g. MaxIteration, Solver), or use net.initialize(Method="powerflow").

net.initialize(Method="powerflow") stopped: the power flow did not converge ({0}). The network was not changed. ''{1}'' is split into {2} islands: {3}. Connect the islands with net.add_branch(...) or remove the unused buses with net.remove_bus(...). An island can only be kept when its own power balances.

net.initialize(Method="OPF") stopped: the AC optimal power flow was not solved ({0}). The network was not changed. ''{1}'' is split into {2} islands: {3}. Connect the islands with net.add_branch(...) or remove the unused buses with net.remove_bus(...). An island can only be kept when its own power balances.

''{0}'' is split into {1} islands: {2}. The power of each island balances, so the operating point is valid, but no power flows between the islands and their angles are unrelated. If this is intended, no change is needed.

net.initialize(Method="equilibrium") stopped: the equilibria of the components do not satisfy the network equations (max |Y*V-I| = {0}). The network was not changed. Use net.initialize(Method="powerflow") or net.initialize(Method="OPF").
net.initialize(Method="equilibrium") stopped: the power flow is stale ({0}). The network was not changed. Run net.initialize() to solve the power flow with these edits.

net.initialize(Method="{0}") stopped: the operating point does not satisfy the network equations (max |Y*V-I| = {1}). The equilibrium is out of date. Check that the slack bus has a component and that the solver tolerance is tight enough, then run net.initialize() again.

net.initialize stopped: the equilibrium of ''{0}'' has the wrong size: x has {1} elements ({2} expected), u has {3} elements ({4} expected). The equilibrium is out of date. Fix get_equilibrium of the model.
net.initialize stopped: {1} of ''{0}'' returned size {2} at the equilibrium; it must have {3} elements (fcn_I: one complex value). The equilibrium is out of date. Fix the model.
net.initialize stopped: {1} of ''{0}'' failed at the equilibrium: {2} The equilibrium is out of date. Fix the model.
net.initialize(Method="equilibrium") stopped: the equilibrium of ''{0}'' is not set. The network was not changed. Run net.initialize(Method="powerflow") or net.initialize(Method="OPF") first.

net.initialize stopped: inputs of components were edited ({0}). Run net.initialize(Method="FixedInput") for the equilibrium with these inputs, or net.initialize(Method="powerflow") to replace them with the power flow solution.
net.initialize(Method="{0}") replaced the inputs edited with set_input by the values of its solution ({1}).
net.initialize(Method="FixedInput") stopped: {0}. The network keeps its previous equilibrium. Check the inputs (rv_Uequilibrium), or try Solver="levenberg-marquardt" or WarmStart=false.
Solver "{0}" cannot be used by net.initialize(Method="FixedInput"): use "newton", "levenberg-marquardt" or "fsolve".
net.initialize(Method="FixedInput") stopped: ''{0}'' is split into {1} islands ({2}), and one slack generator balances one network. Connect the islands or solve them as separate networks.
net.initialize(Method="FixedInput") needs a generator on the slack bus ''{0}'': the Pmech of its first generator balances the power. Set l_isSlack of a bus with a generator.
net.initialize(Method="FixedInput") needs the inputs of every component, but {0} holds none. Set them with comp.set_input(u), or run net.initialize() first.
Cannot read the scenario file {0}: {1}. Nothing was added to the network. Write it again with net.export, or fix the file (Format "GUILDAscenario", version 1).
Ignored unknown fields in the scenario file {0}: {1}. Known fields: {2}.
net.simulate did not reach the end time (flag = {0}); the result holds the trajectories up to the time reached. {1}
No scenario with the tag ''{0}'' was found in ''{1}''. {2}
Slack bus not found. Setting the bus ''{0}'' as the slack bus.
net.simulate stopped: ''{0}'' is not up to date: {1}. Run net.initialize() first.

net.simulate stopped: inputs of components of ''{0}'' were edited ({1}). Run net.initialize(Method="FixedInput") for the equilibrium with these inputs, or net.initialize(Method="powerflow") to replace them with the power flow solution.

The global controller ''{0}'' drives the input ''{1}'' of ''{2}'', but neither the component nor its local controllers have this input now. Attach a local controller with this input, or remove the global controller with net.remove_global_controller(TAG).

Phase {0} (t = [{1}, {2}] s): the open branches {3} leave the buses {4} connected to no component, so their voltages are undetermined. Open branches so that every bus stays connected to a component, or remove those buses from the network.

net.simulate(StopOnOutOfStep=true) compares the rotor angle delta of each generator with that of the generator of the slack bus, but ''{0}'' has no generator with delta on the slack bus ({1}) or no other one to compare (components with delta: {2}). Run without StopOnOutOfStep, or add generators.
